dtype.description: Virtualization driver type (e.g., 'kvm', 'qemu') for the domain.

name.description: Unique name for the virtual machine domain.

memory_kib.description: Amount of RAM allocated to the VM in KiB.

vcpu.description: Number of virtual CPUs assigned to the VM.

machine.description: Machine type/hardware model used by the VM (e.g., 'pc-q35-8.1').

emulator.description: Path to the hypervisor emulator binary used for this domain.
